summary: Follow-up evidence for the existing engineering-readiness review. The four documentation PRs remain open and GitHub reports each mergeable, but Core #7 still requires dependency integration and a fresh-base recheck. RPS-015 remains partial because three successful Workbench release builds from byte-identical source archives produced three different executable hashes. Governance, platform, consumer, release, and rollback gates remain independently pending.
